scope: Read-only review of explicit mode1 source-event preparation, cursor, inspection/UI, callback postprocessor and build-module integration. Worker lifecycle is reviewed separately; this record does not certify GUI or native host equivalence.
checks: Every prepare, resume and seek reuses preserved-source replay and attached-media size/hash verification before a new source snapshot is accepted. Project/root/selection context is checked by the session, and preparation failures exit audition.

Mode1 is explicit and original-rate remains the default. Inspection routes its own admission reason; equal source/project rate is admitted for mode1 without claiming identity filtering. Ordinary project Play/mix barriers remain in place.

Each count planner and playback cursor owns a distinct create/destroy mode1 instance. Seeking reconstructs from source0 with the same8192-frame partitions, preserving suffix output; it does not reuse native reset with retained storage.

The last positive block is final, including exact8192 multiples. Zero-output blocks advance the source and are not mistaken for EOF; visible returned counts must match the count query. No additional NULL drain is inserted.

Event gain follows conversion as a separate Float32 operation. Bounded ring transfer precedes the callback postprocessor with explicit application prefix0/offset0, and a failed buffer is not published.

UI labels identify only the selected event and bypass project effects/mixer/routing/automation. Mode1 text calls the filter reconstructed, describes explicit choice and seek replay, and leaves reference sample equivalence unverified.

Explicit module.modulemap lists exactly all10 public TimingDSP headers. Strict floating-point C flags remain; new header additions are part of the module definition rather than relying on a directory umbrella.
Frozen CPR interpretation profiles and compatibility payloads are not changed by choosing an audition backend.

root_composition_controls: 4 stream tests cover fresh cursors, seek suffixes at4rates, post-filter gain discrimination, planar ring samples, offline tail plus257silence frames and invalid-domain rejection.
Full CPR test pins independent oracle SHA and checks every visible block count for1058400sourceframes at48/32/16/44.1kHz, retained event/media/source custody and changed-media rejection.
3 callback bridge tests distinguish first-plane sentinel action from other-plane contents and reject empty/nonstereo output.
tests.independence: These application composition checks supplement the separate original-instruction/Fraction kernel oracles; a cursor compared to itself is not an independent native sample oracle.

retained_corrections: Earlier stale Clang umbrella-header build failures are retained. The explicit module map resolved the callback integration retry without another cache deletion.
Earlier throwing Swift Testing expression compilation and callback discriminator metadata count corrections are documented in the separate independent reviews.
limitations: Source PCM remains fully resident; converted queue and conversion blocks are bounded. Initial synchronous preparation and seek/preroll can block the caller.
Native availability-based fallback selection is not replayed: mode1 is a user-selected reconstruction, and mode2 uses the separately pinned public backend.
Application queue topology, device scheduling, output-frame quantization and reset/preroll seeking are application policy; hard real-time delivery is not certified.
Kernel sample-domain, FP environment and allocation restrictions are defensive supported-domain gates, not universal vendor behavior.
Inspection readiness does not promise the file remains unchanged; actual preparation rereads and verifies it.
Only the bounded source event is auditioned. Full project tracks, plugins, routing, automation, general placement/fades/warp and Cubase runtime samples remain unverified.
